# Ash Shaw — Neon & UV Makeup Art
# llms.txt — AI agent discoverability file
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## About this site

Ash Shaw is a makeup artist specialising in neon UV blacklight designs, festival face painting, and bold editorial makeup. The site documents a personal art project spanning Berlin club culture, international psytrance festivals, and creative self-expression. The aesthetic is 80s neon CLI — neon pink and neon yellow on atomic black.

## Content inventory

- **Portfolio** (`/portfolio`) — Photo gallery of UV makeup looks, festival face paints, editorial designs, and blacklight photography. Categorised by style (UV, neon, editorial, festival).
- **Blog** (`/blog`) — Articles on makeup techniques, festival culture, UV art, the Berlin scene, and creative process essays.
- **Podcasts** (`/podcasts`) — Audio conversations about makeup artistry, festival culture, creativity, and the intersection of art and nightlife.
- **Videos** (`/videos`) — Tutorial and documentary video content.
- **Events** (`/events`) — Festival appearances, workshop dates, and live events.
- **Book** (`/book`) — "Neon vs Atomic Black" — a book in progress about neon UV makeup art, festival culture, and creative identity.
- **About** (`/about`) — Bio, manifesto, history, and personal sub-pages (ADHD, cats, cycling, fitness, Berlin, music, travels).
- **Style Guide** (`/dev/style-guide`) — Design system documentation.

## Technical

- Stack: React 18 SPA, React Router v7, Vite 6, Tailwind v4
- Content: All content is dynamically rendered. No server-side rendering.
- Sitemap: https://ashshaw.com/sitemap.xml
- Contact: Via website contact page at https://ashshaw.com/contact
